query:
-- Check the last 8 weeks of main check-in data to see the pattern
SELECT weekStartDate, campus, subgroup, headcount
FROM attendance_weekly
WHERE subgroup IN ('Revolution Canton Check-In', 'Revolution Jasper Check-In')
  AND weekStartDate >= '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY weekStartDate DESC, campus
LIMIT 30
